entry_route.value: Applicants can enter from a relevant bachelor's or with previous degrees on the master's-entry route.
entry_route.quote: Hold a rigorous undergraduate degree relevant to the EE curriculum from a reputable institution.

also.quote: Doctor of Philosophy in Electrical Engineering (MS Entry)

funding.value: Fellowships are awarded on a competitive basis; the page does not promise funding to all admitted students.
funding.quote: Award of a fellowship will be based on the criteria required by the sponsor agency (including the graduate school) on a competitive basis.

supervisor.value: The page sets a committee after admission, not a supervisor who must agree before admission.

gre_subject.value: No subject test is named for electrical engineering.

deadline.value: The page refers to an admission deadline but gives no date.

notes: Covers the Electrical Engineering PhD (BS and MS entry). The Computer Engineering PhD (CSE department) says GRE General not required; that rule is not applied here. The department says it 'will give preference' to TOEFL 79 (sections 22/21/20/16) or IELTS 6.5 in all categories; these are preferences, so the university minimums stay.
name: Electrical Engineering PhD
